nbc9170ec4d.headline: Mozambique: Resumption of $20bn Cabo Delgado Gas Project Reignites Both Hope and Resentment
nbc9170ec4d.summary: TotalEnergies has resumed one of the world's largest gas projects in northern Mozambique after a five-year suspension following a deadly jihadist attack. Hopes of jobs and prosperity are raised.
nbc9170ec4d.why: TotalEnergies is a major French integrated energy company, and large LNG projects like this affect global gas supply and host-country revenues.

impacts.name: TotalEnergies
impacts.why: Resuming a major gas project adds future production for the operator.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n2561a1d674.headline: Better but 'not perfect' tax reform wins expert support
n2561a1d674.summary: Some economists say the proposed tax changes are better than the status quo but not perfect. Senators are being urged to pass them despite lobbying from vested interests.
n2561a1d674.why: Tax policy shapes corporate profitability, household spending and fiscal revenue, all of which affect Australian equities and the economic outlook.

nc9bf97d1f1.headline: How Ukraine could join the EU
nc9bf97d1f1.summary: Kyiv is preparing to take the first steps towards joining the European Union while the war with Russia continues.
nc9bf97d1f1.why: EU accession would bring Ukraine into the bloc's single market and funding framework, with long-run effects on regional investment and reconstruction.

n03e9b4e3f9.headline: Will excise cuts be extended so fuel remains cheaper? The government is still thinking about it
n03e9b4e3f9.summary: The government is still considering whether to extend excise cuts so fuel stays cheaper. Simon Harris called the US-Iran peace deal a positive economic development.
n03e9b4e3f9.why: Fuel excise changes directly affect pump prices and consumer inflation in Ireland.

n5aa614c4c0.headline: Haryana rolls out new industrial policy, bets on Gurugram to win back GCC crown
n5aa614c4c0.summary: Haryana has rolled out a new industrial policy aimed at winning back Gurugram's GCC crown. The state is competing with Bengaluru and Hyderabad, which are pulling investment away.
n5aa614c4c0.why: State industrial policies offer incentives that influence where companies, including global capability centres, locate operations in India.

n5b24935346.headline: Chinese Investors to increase Holdings in Pakistan’s CDC, NCCPL after Regulatory Approval
n5b24935346.summary: Chinese strategic investors plan to expand their stakes in key Pakistani capital market entities, CDC and NCCPL, after regulatory approval, signalling a new phase of foreign investment.
n5b24935346.why: CDC and NCCPL are central depository and clearing institutions in Pakistan's capital markets, handling securities settlement and custody.

n5779fa382b.headline: ASX to pay $20.5m penalty for misleading market
n5779fa382b.summary: The Australian Securities Exchange has reached an agreement with the corporate regulator to settle legal action. The settlement includes a $20.5 million penalty for misleading the market.
n5779fa382b.why: ASX operates Australia's main securities exchange, so regulatory penalties affect its reputation and earnings.

n83c781d261.headline: FBR warns of audit action over mismatch between lifestyle, declared income
n83c781d261.summary: The FBR chairman said a fixed Rs25,000 payment does not fully exempt traders from broader tax obligations. He warned of audit action over mismatches between lifestyle and declared income.
n83c781d261.why: The Federal Board of Revenue is Pakistan's federal tax authority, and its enforcement affects tax collection and compliance.

nb9735e3c08.headline: Better but 'not perfect' tax reform wins expert support
nb9735e3c08.summary: Economists say the proposed tax reform is better but not perfect and are urging senators to pass the changes despite vested interests. The reform is before the Senate.
nb9735e3c08.why: Tax settings for investors and government revenue in Australia affect the property market and fiscal policy.

n0a81ef5e31.headline: Will petrol prices drop to Rs300 or below in Pakistan amid US-Iran deal?
n0a81ef5e31.summary: Hopes for lower petrol prices in Pakistan have risen after the announced US-Iran peace agreement. The article asks whether prices could fall to Rs300 or below.
n0a81ef5e31.why: Pakistan imports most of its refined fuel, so global crude prices feed directly into local petrol prices and inflation.

nd144c1e007.headline: ASX 200 Surges Nearly 2% to 8,804 as Iran Peace Hopes Spark Broad Market Rally
nd144c1e007.summary: The ASX 200 rose 1.98% on Friday to 8,804, driven by optimism over a potential US-Iran peace agreement. Energy markets were reported to be stabilising.
nd144c1e007.why: The S&P/ASX 200 is Australia's main benchmark index, covering the country's largest listed companies.
nd144c1e007.why_moved: Optimism over a potential U.S.-Iran peace agreement boosted investor confidence and helped stabilise energy markets.

ne134321dec.headline: Energy experts warn of slow oil supply recovery after Iran deal
ne134321dec.summary: Energy experts say high oil and gas prices and supply problems will not be solved overnight, despite Sunday's agreement to end the Iran war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
ne134321dec.why: Crude oil is a benchmark global commodity, and disruptions through the Strait of Hormuz affect a large share of seaborne oil trade.
ne134321dec.why_moved: Warnings that supply will recover slowly keep a floor under energy prices even after the agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

nadb55c9c0b.headline: India's Razorpay files IPO papers confidentially
nadb55c9c0b.summary: Indian payment gateway provider Razorpay Software has confidentially filed draft papers for an initial public offering, a newspaper advertisement showed on Monday. The filing was reported by Reuters.
nadb55c9c0b.why: Razorpay is a payments company serving Indian businesses. Its listing would be a test case for fintech valuations in India's IPO market.

n657e164797.headline: BMW-built Ora 7 electric wagon surfaces as GWM ditches cute cat branding
n657e164797.summary: Great Wall Motor is moving its Ora brand toward utilitarian vehicle layouts, with an upcoming electric wagon reportedly built with BMW involvement. The Ora 7 has surfaced ahead of launch.
n657e164797.why: Great Wall Motor is a major Chinese automaker with a large electric vehicle business. Its product and brand decisions affect its competitiveness in the fast-growing Chinese EV market.

n0fa54b7a32.headline: SK chief's divorce payout hinges on quadrupled chip stock
n0fa54b7a32.summary: SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won and his former wife failed to settle their property dispute in mediation, sending the case back to court. The payout depends on the value of a chip stock that has quadrupled.
n0fa54b7a32.why: SK Group is a major South Korean conglomerate, and its chairman's ownership stakes influence group governance. SK Hynix is one of its key holdings.

nbbb5e4808d.headline: Even with a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, it could take weeks or months for oil to fully flow
nbbb5e4808d.summary: A tentative agreement to end the war in Iran and reopen the Strait of Hormuz would be good for the global economy. Oil could take weeks or months to fully flow again.
nbbb5e4808d.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of seaborne oil trade, so disruptions there affect global crude supply and prices. Brent crude is the main international oil benchmark.
nbbb5e4808d.why_moved: A tentative deal to end the Iran war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz eases supply disruption concerns, though the input notes flows would take weeks or months to recover.

n8b09bad523.headline: Sensex, Nifty surge over 1 pc as Trump announces Iran deal, Hormuz reopening
n8b09bad523.summary: Indian equities opened sharply higher Monday after US President Donald Trump announced that a deal with Iran had been finalised and the Strait of Hormuz would reopen.
n8b09bad523.why: The BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty 50 are the main benchmark indices of Indian equities. India imports much of its crude oil, so Gulf shipping conditions matter for the economy.
n8b09bad523.why_moved: Trump's announcement of a finalised Iran deal and the Strait of Hormuz reopening reduced geopolitical and energy supply concerns for Indian markets.

na26fac761a.headline: What to know about the finalized deal to end the Iran war
na26fac761a.summary: The United States and Iran are presenting a tentative agreement aimed at ending their war as a victory for each side. The deal's terms were not detailed in the input.
na26fac761a.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key transit route for global crude oil and LNG, so conflict there directly affects energy prices and shipping costs worldwide.

n40e38fc239.headline: U.S. and Iran announce an initial deal to end the war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz
n40e38fc239.summary: The US and Iran announced an initial deal to end the war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Critical issues were set aside for further negotiations, according to the report.
n40e38fc239.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a major chokepoint for global oil and LNG shipments, so its status affects energy prices and global growth.

n0cbae6b244.headline: Exclusive-ByteDance in talks with China
n0cbae6b244.summary: ByteDance is in talks with Shanghai-based Iluvatar CoreX to purchase AI chips for inference work, according to two sources. ByteDance is also considering a similar deal with Baidu.
n0cbae6b244.why: ByteDance owns TikTok and Douyin, and access to AI chips is a key constraint for large-scale AI deployment in China.

n6729b7a60a.headline: Stocks leap worldwide, and oil prices drop after the US and Iran reach a tentative deal on their war
n6729b7a60a.summary: Stock markets rallied worldwide and oil prices eased after the US and Iran reached a tentative deal to restore the global flow of crude. The deal aims to end their war.
n6729b7a60a.why: Crude oil supply through the Middle East is central to global energy prices, and shifts in supply expectations move equity and commodity markets.
n6729b7a60a.why_moved: A tentative US-Iran deal to restore global crude flows reduced supply-disruption concerns, lifting stocks and lowering oil prices.

ne2f3da2d66.headline: US manufacturing output unchanged in May amid tariffs, AI spending surge
ne2f3da2d66.summary: US factory production stayed flat in May as AI spending supported output, offsetting tariffs and energy shocks. Supply delays worsened in surveys.
ne2f3da2d66.why: Manufacturing output is a key indicator of US industrial activity, which influences growth expectations and Federal Reserve policy.

nc34fd9e0df.headline: CATL boss drops solid-state battery reality check: Years away from mass market
nc34fd9e0df.summary: CATL's chief executive said technical parameters will delay commercialization of solid-state batteries in global automotive markets until after 2030. The comments temper expectations for near-term adoption.
nc34fd9e0df.why: CATL is the world's largest maker of electric vehicle batteries, so its technology timelines shape the EV supply chain.

n9bb7825441.headline: Stifel: Diller Likely Has to Bid Higher for MGM to Get Deal Done
n9bb7825441.summary: Stifel analysts say Barry Diller likely has to bid higher for MGM Resorts to get the deal done. The comment is an analyst view on the bidding process.
n9bb7825441.why: MGM Resorts operates casinos and hotels in Las Vegas and elsewhere. Takeover bids affect shareholder value and the valuation of gaming and hospitality assets.

n5e3b28bd03.headline: BYD’s new Denza N8L SUV to launch in China on June 23
n5e3b28bd03.summary: BYD's Denza N8L plug-in hybrid SUV will launch in China on June 23. The model features flash charging and a 75.26 kWh battery.
n5e3b28bd03.why: BYD is a Shenzhen-based carmaker and the largest producer of electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles in China. New launches shape its competitiveness in the world's biggest auto market.

nbfda9a7c50.headline: Cuba and South Korea Ink Trade Agreement: What Does It Encompass?
nbfda9a7c50.summary: The Chamber of Commerce of the Republic of Cuba and the Korea Importers Association have entered into a commercial collaboration agreement. Details of the scope of the deal were limited in the report.
nbfda9a7c50.why: Trade agreements between smaller economies and major Asian trading partners can open new export and import channels for businesses.
